title: Elettaria cardamomum tea for medicinal use
intro: Elettaria cardamomum tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried, ground seeds of the cardamom plant, commonly known as "cardamom." It is used in herbalism for its warming properties and digestive benefits, often helping to alleviate bloating, gas, and indigestion. This tea is also valued for its ability to soothe respiratory issues and promote relaxation due to its calming aroma. In traditional medicine, it is sometimes used to support oral health and freshen breath. Its versatility makes it a popular choice in both culinary and therapeutic applications.
